title: Quick Jamaican Pasta
description: A fusion of Jamaican jerk flavors with Italian pasta for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add jerk seasoning and jamaican allspice (if using) and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in cooked pasta and toss to combine with jerk seasoning mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve with sour cream and parmesan cheese (if using).
